records.name: Branchwise invariant induction
records.statement: If P(x) and every stepRel-step preserves P, then every state reachable from x by reflexive-transitive closure satisfies P.
hypotheses: for all u,v, P(u) and stepRel(u,v) imply P(v)
nonclaims: This does not prove termination, confluence, admissibility, or physical invariance.

records.name: Right-unique rewriting is confluent
records.statement: If stepRel is right-unique, then stepRel is confluent.
hypotheses: for all x,y,z, stepRel(x,y) and stepRel(x,z) imply y=z

records.name: Confluence gives at most one reachable normal form
records.statement: If stepRel is confluent, then from any common source x, any two reachable normal forms are equal.
nonclaims: Confluence alone does not establish existence of a normal form.

records.name: Termination gives reachable normal-form existence
records.statement: If the forward rewrite relation stepRel terminates, every state x reaches at least one normal form.
hypotheses: forward rewriting is terminating, equivalently the swapped relation is well-founded
nonclaims: Existential normalization is not an executable normalizer and does not imply confluence.

records.name: Distinct reachable normal labels refute unique selection
records.statement: If x reaches normal forms n1 and n2 and a label map lambda gives lambda(n1) != lambda(n2), then x does not have at most one reachable normal form; therefore stepRel alone cannot justify a unique-selection claim over lambda.
nonclaims: This theorem does not establish that any particular external scientific package has both branches; those premises must be sourced separately.

derived_corollaries.name: termination-and-confluence-give-exactly-one-reachable-normal-form
derived_corollaries.statement: If stepRel terminates and is confluent, then every x has exactly one reachable normal form.

deferred_theorem_targets.name: Newman's lemma
deferred_theorem_targets.reason: Requires a complete repository well-founded-induction proof before advertisement.
